english.title: Refuse to answer question put / comply with requirement made by registrar concerning birth / death or dead body
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953 to give information concerning a

(A)_[birth,]_
(B)_[death,]_
(C)_[dead body,]_

(D)_[wilfully refused to answer a question put by the registrar relating to the particulars required to be registered concerning the birth,]_
(E)_[wilfully refused to answer a question put by the registrar relating to the particulars required to be registered concerning the death,]_
(F)_[failed to comply with a requirement of the registrar made under the Births and Deaths Registration 1953,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY QUESTION OR REQUIREMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 36(a) of the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953.
